source.note: The CoinGecko free tier stops at 365 days on market_chart, so five years of history comes from Yahoo instead.

direction.note: A zero-return forecast never calls a direction, so there is no accuracy to report.

baseline.label: Naive persistence (predict no change)
baseline.note: Predicts a 0% move tomorrow. Price-space R2 looks excellent for this row as well, because one-day-ahead prices are dominated by yesterday's price. Read the return-space R2 and the MAPE instead.

forecast.method: Recursive multi-step. Each predicted close is appended to the history and the features are recomputed before the next day, so step two onward is forecasting our own output. The band is 1.96 x ensemble test RMSE scaled by sqrt(h), which is why it widens.

pipeline.title: Collect five years of daily bars
pipeline.body: 1776 daily candles for BTC-USD run from 2021-11-11 to 2026-09-21, pulled from the Yahoo Finance chart endpoint. One HTTP request, no API key.

pipeline.title: Engineer technical features
pipeline.body: 32 inputs are derived from price and volume: returns and lags, moving-average distance, RSI, MACD, Bollinger position, rolling volatility, ATR, volume pressure and calendar cycles. Each row predicts the next day, never the day it describes.

pipeline.title: Split in chronological order
pipeline.body: The first 1420 rows train the models and the last 356 rows are held back untouched. The cut sits at 2025-10-01. Time series are never shuffled, so the split follows the calendar to stop the models from reading the future.

pipeline.title: Score both models with walk-forward validation
pipeline.body: 5 expanding-window folds run inside the training block. Each fold trains up to that point and validates on the slice just after it, which reproduces how the model would really be used.

pipeline.title: Weight the ensemble by cross-validation error
pipeline.body: XGBoost averaged 0.02923 RMSE and Gradient Boosting averaged 0.0302. Weights are the inverse of those squared errors, which produced 52% and 48%. The test set had no say.

pipeline.title: Judge the blend against held-out prices
pipeline.body: On 356 unseen days the ensemble reached R2 0.982, a mean price error of $1,435 and 50.56% directional accuracy. These are the numbers the models never saw while learning.
